title: Protein and DNA Conformational Changes Contribute to Specificity of Cre Recombinase
authors: Jonathan S. Montgomery; Megan E. Judson; Mark P. Foster
one_liner_zh: 该文通过ITC、CD和NMR实验研究Cre重组酶与loxP DNA的识别机制，揭示C端自抑制和DNA弯曲的构象变化对特异性贡献，虽聚焦蛋白-DNA互作但方法为实验手段，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故为中档匹配。
abstract: Cre, a conservative site-specific tyrosine recombinase, is a powerful gene editing tool in the laboratory. Expanded applications in human health are hindered by lack of understanding of the mechanism by which Cre selectively binds and recombines its cognate loxP sequences. This knowledge is essential for retargeting the enzyme to new sites and for mitigating effects of off-target recombination. Prior studies have suggested that in addition to a few base-specific contacts to cognate loxP DNA, specificity is enhanced by (1) autoinhibition involving a conformational change in the C-terminal helix of Cre, and (2) indirect readout via binding-coupled conformational changes in the target DNA. We used isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC), circular dichroism (CD) and heteronuclear NMR spectroscopy to investigate DNA site recognition by wild-type Cre and a deletion mutant lacking the C-terminal helix. ITC of Cre and a C-terminal deletion variant against cognate and non-cognate DNA recombinase binding elements (RBEs) reveal that the C-terminus reduces DNA binding affinity by six-fold towards cognate DNA. Additionally, ITC revealed highly unfavorable binding enthalpy, which when combined with evidence from CD and NMR of structural differences between cognate and non-cognate complexes support a model in which binding-coupled DNA bending provides a unique structure-thermodynamic signature of cognate complexes. Together, these findings advance our understanding of site-recognition by Cre recombinase.
abstract_zh: Cre是一种保守的位点特异性酪氨酸重组酶，是实验室中强大的基因编辑工具。其在人类健康领域的扩展应用受到对Cre选择性结合并重组其同源loxP序列机制缺乏理解的阻碍。这一知识对于将该酶重新靶向至新位点以及减轻脱靶重组效应至关重要。先前研究表明，除了对同源loxP DNA的少数碱基特异性接触外，特异性还通过以下机制增强：（1）自抑制，涉及Cre C末端螺旋的构象变化，以及（2）通过靶DNA结合偶联构象变化的间接读取。我们使用等温滴定量热法（ITC）、圆二色光谱（CD）和异核NMR波谱研究野生型Cre及缺失C末端螺旋的删除突变体对DNA位点的识别。针对同源和非同源DNA重组酶结合元件（RBE）的Cre及C末端删除变体的ITC结果显示，C末端使同源DNA的结合亲和力降低六倍。此外，ITC揭示了高度不利的结合焓，这与CD和NMR证据表明同源与非同源复合物之间存在结构差异相结合，支持一个模型，即结合偶联的DNA弯曲为同源复合物提供了独特的结构-热力学特征。综合来看，这些发现增进了我们对Cre重组酶位点识别的理解。
